test_cases.name: check_hub_on_phone
test_cases.input: Check the hub site works on a phone.
assertions: Runs node scripts/phone_harness.mjs against the repo root
Passes --out to a directory outside the repo
Reports FAIL and WARN counts from the actual run
Says the result is Chromium emulation, not a real iPhone or Safari

test_cases.name: fix_overflow_at_280
test_cases.input: The legal page side-scrolls on my folded phone. Fix it.
assertions: Runs the harness with --viewports galaxy-fold or the default set
Fixes the element named in the horizontal scroll FAIL line
Re-runs the harness and shows the FAIL line gone before claiming it is fixed

test_cases.name: mobile_screenshots
test_cases.input: Give me phone screenshots of every page before I publish.
assertions: Runs the harness with screenshots on
Does not commit screenshots into the repo

test_cases.name: does_not_claim_live_site
test_cases.input: Is malachaigrant01-droid.github.io mobile friendly right now?
assertions: States the harness tests local files, not the deployed URL
Does not claim the live site passes without saying the local copy was tested
